import Pkg

try
    yaml_path = tempname() * ".yaml"
    open(yaml_path, "w") do f
        write(f, "mesh_type: triangle\nbox_length: [1.0, 1.0]\nperiodic: [false, false]\ngmsh_options:\n  Mesh.CharacteristicLengthMax: 0.2\n")
    end

    include("/scratch/coop/drozda/unstructured-mesh-writer/writer_gmsh.jl")

    # Patch: this gmsh Julia binding takes optional args positionally,
    # not as Julia keywords. These three functions replace the ones
    # include() just loaded, to test the fix before it lands in the
    # file on disk.
    function _edge_markers_from_curve_groups(markers, edge_index::Dict{Tuple{Int,Int},Int}, tag_to_idx::Dict{Int,Int}, n_edges::Int)
        edge_mk = zeros(Int32, n_edges)
        for marker in markers
            for curve_tag in gmsh.model.getEntitiesForPhysicalGroup(1, marker)
                etypes, _, enodes = gmsh.model.mesh.getElements(1, Int(curve_tag))
                for (et, en) in zip(etypes, enodes)
                    et != 1 && continue
                    for k in 1:2:length(en)
                        a = tag_to_idx[Int(en[k])]
                        b = tag_to_idx[Int(en[k+1])]
                        key = a < b ? (a, b) : (b, a)
                        row = get(edge_index, key, nothing)
                        row !== nothing && (edge_mk[row + 1] = marker)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return edge_mk
    end

    function _build_2d_gmsh(cfg::Dict)
        Lx, Ly = cfg["box_length"]
        obstacles = cfg["obstacles"]
        _validate_obstacles(obstacles, cfg["box_length"], 2)
        gmsh.initialize()
        local pts, cells, edges, pt_mk, edge_mk
        obstacle_meta = NamedTuple[]
        try
            gmsh.option.setNumber("General.Terminal", 0)
            gmsh.model.add("triangle_mesh")
            box = gmsh.model.occ.addRectangle(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, Lx, Ly)
            obstacle_tags = Int[]
            for obs in obstacles
                if obs["shape"] == "circle"
                    cx, cy = Float64.(obs["center"]); r = Float64(obs["radius"])
                    push!(obstacle_tags, gmsh.model.occ.addDisk(cx, cy, 0.0, r, r))
                else
                    cx, cy = Float64.(obs["center"]); hx, hy = Float64.(obs["half_extents"])
                    push!(obstacle_tags, gmsh.model.occ.addRectangle(cx-hx, cy-hy, 0.0, 2hx, 2hy))
                end
            end
            if !isempty(obstacle_tags)
                gmsh.model.occ.cut([(2, box)], [(2, t) for t in obstacle_tags])
            end
            gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()
            curve_tags = [t for (_, t) in gmsh.model.occ.getEntities(1)]
            box_groups, leftover = _classify_box_curves_2d(curve_tags, Lx, Ly)
            obstacle_groups, unmatched = _match_obstacle_entities(leftover, obstacles, 2)
            if !isempty(unmatched)
                _log("  [warn] triangle: $(length(unmatched)) boundary curve(s) match no obstacle and no box face")
            end
            markers_desc = Int[]
            for marker in sort(collect(values(_MK2)), rev=true)
                tags = box_groups[marker]
                if !isempty(tags)
                    gmsh.model.addPhysicalGroup(1, tags, marker)
                    push!(markers_desc, marker)
                end
            end
            for (idx, obs) in enumerate(obstacles)
                marker = 10 + (idx - 1)
                tags = get(obstacle_groups, idx - 1, Int[])
                if !isempty(tags)
                    gmsh.model.addPhysicalGroup(1, tags, marker)
                    push!(markers_desc, marker)
                else
                    _log("  [warn] triangle: obstacle $(idx-1): found no boundary curve for marker $marker")
                end
                push!(obstacle_meta, _obstacle_record(obs, marker))
            end
            for (k, v) in cfg["gmsh_options"]
                gmsh.option.setNumber(k, v)
            end
            gmsh.model.mesh.generate(2)
            pts, tag_to_idx = _map_gmsh_nodes()
            _, raw = gmsh.model.mesh.getElementsByType(2)
            n_cells = length(raw) ÷ 3
            raw_cells = permutedims(reshape(raw, 3, n_cells))
            cells = [tag_to_idx[Int(raw_cells[ci,k])] for ci in 1:n_cells, k in 1:3]
            cells = _fix_cell_orientation(pts, cells, 2)
            edges, edge_index = _build_edge_registry(cells, 2)
            pt_mk = _point_markers_from_groups(1, sort(markers_desc, rev=true), tag_to_idx, size(pts,1))
            edge_mk = _edge_markers_from_curve_groups(markers_desc, edge_index, tag_to_idx, size(edges,1))
        finally
            gmsh.finalize()
        end
        return pts, cells, edges, pt_mk, edge_mk, obstacle_meta
    end

    main(yaml_path)

    h5_path = replace(yaml_path, r"\.ya?ml$" => ".h5")
    xdmf_path = replace(yaml_path, r"\.ya?ml$" => ".xdmf")

    n_vertices = n_cells = n_edges = 0
    h5open(h5_path, "r") do f
        n_vertices = attrs(f)["n_vertices"]
        n_cells = attrs(f)["n_cells"]
        n_edges = attrs(f)["n_edges"]
    end

    result["status"] = "ok"
    result["n_vertices"] = n_vertices
    result["n_cells"] = n_cells
    result["n_edges"] = n_edges
    result["h5_exists"] = isfile(h5_path)
    result["xdmf_exists"] = isfile(xdmf_path)
catch e
    result["status"] = "error"
